jobs.description:
Do you have experience in woodworking and take pride in delivering high-quality craftsmanship?

We are looking for a Production Worker Woodworking to help manufacture and assemble bespoke kitchens and custom-made furniture in a modern production environment.

Salary: starting at 17 euro bruto per hour + meal vouchers

• Producing and assembling custom kitchens and fixed furniture solutions.

• Working on high-end interior projects with great attention to detail and finishing quality.

• Reading and interpreting technical drawings and plans.

• Operating woodworking machinery and tools.

• Contributing to an efficient and smooth production process.

• You have completed a technical or vocational education in woodworking.

• You have previous experience as a woodworker, cabinet maker, or production worker in a similar role.

• You can read and interpret technical drawings.

• You possess strong technical skills and practical insight.

• You work in an organized and structured manner.

• You are flexible and able to perform well under pressure.

• You communicate fluently in English.

• You enjoy working as part of a team but can also work independently when required.

We are looking for an enthusiastic grinder for our production department.

Our client is an international player in modular systems for events, stand construction and so on.

Duties:

- grinding and deburring of aluminum profiles.

- alternating between serial work and piece work

- entering and processing orders in the computer

You have experience within the metal sector or have completed technical studies.

You can work with the computer

You have a good command of the English language

jobs.occupation: Customer Service Officer Polish - German - English
jobs.description:
As a Customer Service Representative, you will work Monday to Friday in rotating shifts between 7:00 AM and 10:00 PM.

• Answer phone calls and emails from customers and partners.

• Collect and verify information.

• Provide technical support and maintain contact with repair workshops.

• Keep customers and all involved parties informed in a timely manner.

• Follow up on agreements and ensure all information is correctly processed in the customer file.

• You speak and write Polish, German, and English fluently to assist our customers effectively.

• You are comfortable working with computer systems and can multitask.

• You have strong communication skills and can handle phone calls and emails professionally.

• You are solution-oriented and always strive to provide the best support to customers.

Searching for a job in Sales? Eager to learn everything from the bottom to the top?

Want to work in a company who's values are doing the right thing, doing waht is best for the customer and driven in improvements and innovations?

This internationaly active production company is looking for a highly self-motivated, results oriented and solutions driven Management Trainee with a general interest in all levels of a business and a general interest in developing new technologies. After completing the management trainee program, you will be assigned to a full-time position in Sales.

The client's management trainee program is designed for recent university graduates who are highly motivated and have the potential to excel as future global leaders at the company. The training program is customized to meet the skills of the employee along with the needs of the company.

It offers challenging work assignments along with hands on training in manufacturing, quality control, administration, sales & marketing, and logistics. You will be exposed to all areas of the business and learn by successfully completing various projects in the different departments.

• A master or bachelor degree.

• If you have already strong sales skills for new account development that would be an advantage.

• 2 years of previous work experiences.

• A fluent pen and verbal skills in English and Dutch. Any additional languages would be great.

• Able to work autonomously, in a structured and efficient way.

• Strong sense of urgency, listening, communication and organizational skills.

As Key Account Manager, you grow the company's business with industrial customers across Europe. You look after existing customers, and you bring in new ones. You spend a lot of time visiting customers, and you work closely with the logistics and purchasing team at headquarters.
    
• Manage and develop existing key accounts in Europe  
• Winning new customers in the company's current markets and applications  
• Spot and develop new projects with customers, from the first technical conversation through to supply  
• Negotiate prices and terms, keeping the agreed margins in mind  
• Prepare the yearly sales budget, track volumes and margin every month  
• Keep a close eye on the market, competitors and customer needs, and share what you learn with the team 
  
• At least 3 years of experience in B2B sales in the chemical industry; experience in coatings, adhesives, sealants or polymer applications is a strong plus  
• You have built your own network of customers in the industry and can add value from your first day  
• You like developing new business and you are fully hands-on; you get your energy from working with customers  
• You think like an entrepreneur and understand financial figures, because you manage your own budget and margins  
• You are interested in the technical side of the products and can talk about them confidently with buyers and R&D teams  
• You are fluent in English, any other European language is an asset  
• You are happy to travel regularly to customers across Europe

• You act as the first point of contact for key users and ensure timely and high-quality resolution of incidents within our supply chain applications. 
• You perform root cause analysis, identify sustainable solutions, and help prevent recurring issues. 
• You gather user feedback and translate business needs into improvements that enhance operational efficiency and user experience. 
• You maintain system and process documentation, provide training, and support users in strengthening their knowledge and capabilities. 
• You contribute to continuous improvement initiatives within SAP S/4HANA, SAP Fiori, and other supply chain solutions. 
• You support international expansion projects, such as new production sites or warehouse locations, and play an active role in testing and user acceptance activities. 
• You build strong relationships with business stakeholders and proactively identify opportunities to optimize processes and systems. 
• You participate in international roll-out projects and facilitate knowledge transfer across the organization.  
As a Service Engineer Supply Chain, you report directly to the Business Applications Team Service Lead and are part of LLBG's international IT team.

 
• You hold a Master's degree or have an equivalent level of experience. 
• You have experience working with ERP systems & knowledge of SAP S/4HANA. 
• You have at least 2 years of experience with Supply Chain, Manufacturing, or Plant Operations processes. 
• You combine strong analytical skills with a customer-focused and service-oriented mindset. 
• You communicate fluently in English and enjoy working with a wide range of stakeholders in an international environment.

For our client in the Kortrijk region, we are looking for a motivated Carpet Finishing Operator to strengthen our team on the finishing line.

 

• Cutting and finishing carpets to size

• Processing carpets on the finishing line

• Carrying out quality checks

• Attaching fringes when necessary

• Applying labels to carpets

• Ensuring a neat and high-quality finish

Job Requirements:

• You are precise and enjoy working with your hands

• You have an eye for quality and attention to detail

• You can work independently, but you are also a team player

• Experience in carpets, textiles or garment manufacturing is a plus

• Experience is not required: motivation and a positive work attitude are important

• You speak Dutch, French or English

Are you an experienced CNC operator looking for a new challenge? We urgently need skilled professionals to join our team at our brand-new machine shop! Our workshop has moved to a location 10 times larger with many more machines, and we’re looking for enthusiastic people to help us grow!

• Experience in CNC programming, turning, and milling (if you only have turning experience, we have options, but milling experience alone is not sufficient).
• Experience with 5-axis machines and knowledge of more than 3-axis operations.
• Familiarity with Fanuc, Siemens, and Mazatrol Smooth.
• English is sufficient for communication in our workshop.
• Willingness to work in Day shift. We are open to considering day shifts.
• 95% of programming happens at the machine using dialog control (ShopMill and ShopTurn, Siemens 840D Solution Line).
• You must have a good understanding of G- and M-codes.

Do you enjoy precision shaping pipes and creating strong welds for technical installations? As a TIG or semi-automatic welder, you'll work on a variety of HVAC projects within the construction sector. You'll read plans, build custom installations, and weld pipes into perfect assemblies for heating and plumbing. Depending on the project, you'll work both on-site and in the workshop, preparing and assembling components. Thanks to the variety of high-end projects, your job remains technically challenging and educational. You'll be part of a large team where collaboration, quality, and safety are paramount.

What are your tasks?

• Reading and interpreting technical plans
• Bending, grinding, and welding pipes (TIG/semi-automatic)
• Preparing and assembling installations in the workshop and on-site

• Experience as a welder in a technical or construction environment
• Communicate in English or Romanian
• Possession of a driver's license

Our client is looking for a dynamic and enthusiastic Junior Associate with a strong interest in the financial sector and an affinity for IT and digital solutions to join its Operations department.
The Operations department consists of approximately 60 colleagues based in Brussels and manages a broad range of services related to banking products and transactions.
These activities include post-trade processing, cash and payment services, portfolio transfers, tax services, income and corporate actions, and account administration.

 
As an Operations – Cash & Payments Junior Associate, you will: 

 
• Process payment and treasury transactions accurately and efficiently, ensuring high-quality data and excellent service to both internal and external clients. 
 
• Perform operational support activities based on scheduled or ad hoc requests, including account closures, interest adjustments, reconciliation as well as investigation and controls on transactions 
 
• Contribute to the development and implementation of new processes and systems, as well as the continuous improvement of existing ones, with the aim of increasing efficiency, complying with new regulations and market standards, and reducing operational risk. 
 
• Proactively follow and integrate operational and procedural changes to keep your knowledge and expertise up to date. 
 
• Participate in knowledge sharing and training, both receiving training from colleagues and sharing your own expertise across the department. 

 
• A Master's degree or equivalent experience, preferably within the financial sector. 
 
• French or Dutch as your main language, combined with a very good command of the other national language and English. 
 
• A collaborative mindset and a genuine willingness to learn and share knowledge. 
 
• A dynamic, proactive and confident personality. 
 
• A strong client-focused mindset and good communication skills. 
 
• Strong analytical skills, combined with the ability to synthesize complex information. 
 
• Good knowledge of Microsoft Office and strong general digital skills.

• Perform a variety of laboratory tests according to standard procedures 
 
• Work with pH meters, viscometers, colorimeters, spectrophotometers, ovens and incubators 
 
• Test enzyme activity in finished products 
 
• Sample incoming laboratory materials 
 
• Carry out wash tests on fabric samples 
 
• Collect water, air, equipment swab, environmental and raw-material samples 
 
• Prepare product batches for different departments 
 
• Calibrate equipment and replace Millipore filters 
 
• Register ICE tickets and maintain accurate laboratory data 
 
• Help improve procedures and workflows 
 
• Follow quality and safety procedures with care and consistency 

You have an A2 qualification in Sciences/Chemistry or relevant laboratory experience, and you are comfortable communicating in English.

Has an eye for detail
Takes quality seriously
Enjoys practical laboratory work
Is comfortable with Microsoft Office
Follows procedures while looking for opportunities to improve the way things are done

• Prepare, set up, and operate pilot plant equipment for testing activities 
 
• Perform assigned tests and experiments according to established procedures 
 
• Reconfigure, adjust, and rebuild machine components when required 
 
• Collect, retrieve, and document test data accurately 
 
• Verify data quality and report any anomalies to your supervisor or technical coach 
 
• Support administrative and reporting tasks related to testing activities 
 
• Learn and execute new testing methods with a strong focus on quality and reliability 
 
• Collaborate closely with engineers, scientists, and technical specialists 

 
• Mechanical or electromechanical education or experience 
 
• Strong hands-on technical skills 
 
• Comfortable working with machinery and equipment 
 
• Excellent accuracy and attention to detail 
 
• Good computer skills and confidence using software applications 
 
• Ability to communicate effectively in English, both written and spoken 
 
• Proactive attitude and willingness to ask questions when neededImportant to know: 
 
• The role can be physically demanding at times 
 
• Some tasks may require working in less comfortable or awkward positions 
 
• While you will not have overall project ownership, your contribution is critical to the success of research and development projects

As a Legal Assistant in Brussels, you will provide organised administrative and secretarial support within a Professional Services setting. You will help keep daily legal documentation, correspondence and diary activities running smoothly for the business.

Client Details

The organisation operates in the Professional Services industry in Brussels.

Description

As a Legal Assistant your responsibilities are:

• Prepare & format legal documents, letters and presentations to ensure clear and accurate output.
• Manage calendars, arrange meetings and coordinate appointments to support efficient daily planning.
• Organise files and maintain document records so information is easy to find when needed.
• Handle incoming and outgoing correspondence in a timely and professional manner
• Assistance with hotel and travel arrangements, taxis orders, restaurants reservations, preparations of expense reports, occasional assistance with roaming updates, occasional assistance with visa applications
• Billing assistance (formatting, saving, printing and coordination with Billing team), keep track of recorded client invoices
• Support the preparation of reports and documents for ongoing legal and business activities.
 

A successful Legal Assistant should have:

• Ideally you already have an experience in a similar function within a law firm
• English / French or Dutch
• Strong administrative and secretarial support skills.
• Confidence in managing diaries, meetings and changing priorities.
• Good document organisation and record-management capability.
• Clear written communication skills for professional correspondence.

You will join an international and multilingual working environment where customers receive daily assistance when their car or truck breaks down on the road. Du wirst Teil eines internationalen und mehrsprachigen Arbeitsumfelds, in dem Kunden täglich geholfen wird, wenn ihr Auto oder Lkw unterwegs eine Panne hat. 

• Die deutsche Übersetzung unten.
• You answer phone calls and emails from customers and other parties involved.
• You collect the necessary information and check that all details are correct and complete.
• You provide technical support and stay in contact with garages and repair workshops.
• You keep customers and all other parties involved informed about the progress.
• You follow up on agreements and make sure everyone involved respects them.
• You handle contract-related questions and issues within the agreed deadlines.
• You work from Monday to Friday, with flexibility to work on Saturdays during busy periods.
• You work in rotating shifts between 7 AM and 10 PM.
• Du beantwortest Telefonanrufe und E-Mails von Kunden und anderen beteiligten Parteien.
• Du sammelst die erforderlichen Informationen und überprüfst, ob alle Angaben korrekt und vollständig sind.
• Du bietest technische Unterstützung und stehst in Kontakt mit Werkstätten und Reparaturbetrieben.
• Du hältst Kunden und alle anderen Beteiligten über den aktuellen Stand auf dem Laufenden.
• Du verfolgst getroffene Vereinbarungen und stellst sicher, dass alle Beteiligten diese einhalten.
• Du bearbeitest vertragsbezogene Fragen und Probleme innerhalb der vereinbarten Fristen.
• Du arbeitest von Montag bis Freitag und bist bereit, in arbeitsintensiven Zeiten auch samstags zu arbeiten.
• Du arbeitest in wechselnden Schichten zwischen 7:00 und 22:00 Uhr.

• Die deutsche Übersetzung unten.
• You speak and write English very well and have a good knowledge of German and Dutch.
• You are comfortable working with Microsoft Office, including Word, Excel and Outlook.
• Knowledge of the automotive sector, such as cars or tyres, is an advantage but not a requirement.
• Previous customer service experience is not required.
• Motivation and the right attitude are more important.
• You communicate fluently and professionally over the phone.
• You can analyse problems and find appropriate solutions.
• You are customer-oriented, results-driven and work accurately.
• You can multitask and remain calm under pressure.
• Du sprichst und schreibst sehr gut Englisch und verfügst über gute Deutsch- und Niederländischkenntnisse.
• Du arbeitest sicher mit Microsoft Office, insbesondere Word, Excel und Outlook.
• Kenntnisse in der Automobilbranche, beispielsweise im Bereich Autos oder Reifen, sind von Vorteil, aber keine Voraussetzung.
• Erfahrung im Kundenservice ist nicht erforderlich.
• Motivation und die richtige Einstellung sind wichtiger.
• Du kommunizierst sicher und professionell am Telefon.
• Du kannst Probleme analysieren und passende Lösungen finden.
• Du bist kunden- und ergebnisorientiert und arbeitest sorgfältig.
• Du kannst mehrere Aufgaben gleichzeitig erledigen

For our client, an international player within logistics with several branches worldwide and in Belgium, we are looking for a GL Accountant.

They offer various logistics solutions through their extensive network of offices, partners and warehouses.

They are looking to strengthen their team in Puurs and are looking for a GL Accountant.

Jobomschrijving

For the position as GL Accountant at our client in the Antwerp region, we are looking for someone who is fascinated by the following range of tasks:

• You will process the complete accounting for the assigned companies and countries.
• You prepare the monthly and annual financial close of the assigned entities.
• You align accounting and operational processes.
• You will be responsible for the balance sheet analysis and monthly reconciliation of assigned entities.
• You prepare monthly, quarterly and year-end internal and group reports.
• You provide monitoring of costs, accruals and provisions in collaboration with the controlling team and local teams.
• You participate in the annual budgeting process.
• You foresee the closing of general ledger accounts and financial reporting.
• You participate in the annual external audit process if required.
• You will work closely with the Financial Controllers team in this process.
• You will always work on a country or entity based in Western Europe.

To fulfil this role of GL Accountant, you recognise yourself in the following profile:

• You hold a bachelor’s or master’s degree in Accounting.
• You have a first experience as a GL Accountant.
• You have a strong analytical mindset and attention to detail.
• You are fluent in English.
• You have a good knowledge of balance sheet analysis, monthly, quarterly, and yearly closing processes, IFRS, and reconciliations.
• SAP experience is advantageous.
• You are a team player who thrives in an international environment.

We are looking for a motivated and hands-on Workshop Technician to join our technical team in Huizingen. In this role, you will be responsible for maintaining, repairing, and preparing material handling equipment, ensuring our customers receive reliable and high-quality machines. This is an excellent opportunity for a technician who enjoys solving technical challenges and wants to work in a dynamic and growing environment. Key Responsibilities : 

 
• Perform preventive maintenance and repairs on warehouse and material handling equipment. 
 

 
• Diagnose mechanical, electrical, and hydraulic faults. 
 
•  
Prepare new equipment for delivery and commissioning. 

 
• Conduct inspections and quality checks. 
 

 
• Test equipment following repairs and maintenance work. 
 

 
• Complete service reports and technical documentation accurately. 
 

 
• Ensure compliance with health, safety, and quality standards. 
 

 
• Collaborate with colleagues to deliver excellent technical service. 

Technical education or relevant experience in mechanics, electromechanics, automotive technology, or a related field. Experience working on machinery, industrial vehicles, forklifts, or similar equipment is an advantage. 
Strong troubleshooting and diagnostic skills. Basic knowledge of electrical and hydraulic systems. 
Ability to work independently and as part of a team. 
Reliable, proactive, and solution-oriented. Valid Category B driving licence. 
Very good knowledge of English
